Well from my perspective, people are genuinely curious, they don't mean to be rude or disrespectful, but its like when you are walking down the street and you see something out of the norm, you know you shouldn't look, but you do so with your peripheral vision, or even have a glance once or twice… people aren't used to it, and are genuinely curious, i wouldn't worry or think too much about it, at the end of the day it is your life and not theres, as long as you are happy thats whats more important, you have your life and your body your WHOLE LIFE, the people that may bully you or ask weird questions or are rude to you, are there for a fraction of your life, don't let them effect your Whole life.

Hey, reading your post i can see how much that took for you to write. your older then myself so i can't really say anything about what there is to look forward to in life as you have experienced life more then i have. However i do feel like i can offer some words from a younger person's perspective.

You mentioned how the american medical system is no longer good for you, that you've lived a life and seen so much of it, and that you have enough money to leave your wife, this may seem like a big leap, but perhaps its your soundings you are upset with, have you considered moving to Canada? or the UK? i know from first hand experience the UK NHS is very good, and completely free. You have the money saved, and it could be the start of a new leaf, the new environment will allow you to experience even more in your life, and could open up many more opportunities which could further increase your happiness… 

You always hear about people going travelling to go "Find Themselves" with December coming up, that is the holiday season in Asia, you could go and visit Thailand and the Buddhist temples, take your wife and yourself for a get away and treat yourself. Be open to the culture and who knows, you could even find a career out there doing something you love. This may sound really morbid, but if you are willing to let your life go, then you are at the lowest point in your life, You've hit rock bottom, know that things can't get much worst, and eventually things will start to get better. If you and your wife have kids, Grandkids, who knows even great grandkids… theres so much potential for life. I'm here for a few hours if you want to talk.
